arguments.rule_content:
title: Suspicious Rundll32 Execution From Temp
id: e9b4e219-2981-4555-90cc-f6a0e1e11564
description: Detects suspicious rundll32 execution from temporary directories, which is a common technique used by malware and attackers.
status: experimental
date: 2026/05/05
author: SOC Improvements
references:
    - Internal Incident INC-2026-0505
    - https://thedfirmware.github.io/posts/shellcode-run-dll/
    - https://blog.malwaremustdie.org/2017/12/cobalt-strike-powershell-infection_25.html
    - https://www.fireeye.com/cyber-research/2016/03/techniques_to_eva.html
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection_img:
        Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
    selection_path:
        - CommandLine|contains: '\Temp\'
        - CommandLine|contains: '\Temporary\'
    condition: selection_img and (selection_path|any)
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate applications using rundll32 from temp directories
level: high
